title: Jude and the Tide
author: Isandro Thackeray
blurb: Petra Winterbourne, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
